governance_principle: Technical accessibility does not imply permission to persist, redistribute, publish, or use a source in production. Each source must separately pass identity, timestamp, point-in-time, reliability, cost, and rights review for its intended use.

sources.freshness_note: nflverse documents game/schedule data updates about every five minutes during the season
sources.market_use_policy: Treat home_moneyline/away_moneyline as an upstream benchmark, not as a named sportsbook or a verified multi-book consensus.
sources.rights_status: existing_project_source; preserve source attribution and review any underlying-source redistribution constraints before expanding publication

sources.coverage: US-region NFL h2h endpoint can return multiple bookmaker objects in one request, including bookmaker key/title and last_update metadata when supplied by the provider.
sources.quota_model: 1 usage credit per market per region; the planned NFL h2h + US request costs 1 credit
sources.free_tier_note: Provider currently advertises a 500-credit/month Starter plan.
sources.collection_policy: Query only inside the research near-kickoff window; one request services the whole due-game cluster. Track x-requests-used, x-requests-remaining, and x-requests-last; stop at a configured reserve.
sources.book_policy: De-vig each book separately; retain per-book values and timestamps; derive a robust logit consensus. Do not silently collapse FanDuel, DraftKings, BetMGM, or other books into an unattributed number.

sources.ingestion_policy: Use provider/aggregator API data rather than direct site scraping unless separately reviewed.
sources.combination_policy: De-vig independently and retain source identity; eligible for sportsbook-family consensus only.

family_rules.sportsbooks: May be aggregated only after each source is independently de-vigged and timestamped. Preserve per-book provenance and source count.
family_rules.prediction_exchanges: Never mix into sportsbook consensus by default. Evaluate as a separate information family with liquidity and microstructure controls.
family_rules.availability: Pregame player availability must be point-in-time reproducible, stable-ID mapped, and known by the tested forecast horizon. Actual snaps/participation are prohibited proxies.
family_rules.historical_vs_prospective: Closing historical markets may benchmark information quality but cannot establish the best T-minus lock horizon. Lock-horizon selection requires prospective matched-horizon observations.
